'''Vivian''' is a female NPC Acolyte that appears at [[Ragunna City]] nearby the [[City Square]] Fountain.

{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Vivian:''' These children are still too young to understand that these Echoes are blessings from Imperator.
:'''Vivian:''' Ragunna's unity today relies on the assistance of these Common Echoes.
:'''Vivian:''' Come down, little one...
:{{DIcon}} Children see a Mercurio and think it's just that—a toy.
:{{DIcon}} It's only normal.
:'''Vivian:''' If we don't treat them as family and friends, how can we expect Imperator's mercy?
:'''Vivian:''' So please, stop riding on it...
